title: 龙泰资管郝洪：央行新增资金流向高科技，房地产投资持续下降，经济结构转型加速
speaker: How Home

segments.en: Yeah, well, I think back then, you know, the story really is that, you know, when the PBOC eased monetary policy, the Chinese market would rally.
segments.zh: 是的，过去的情况是，当央行放松货币政策时，中国市场就会上涨。

segments.en: Well, I think, you know, ever since 2023, after COVID and the economy reopened for business, you know, we're actually seeing the newly created money on the PBOC balance sheet. It's actually going into the newer sectors, you know, for example, the semi-names we discussed just now.
segments.zh: 但自2023年疫情后经济重启以来，我们看到央行资产负债表上的新增资金实际上流向了新兴行业，比如我们刚才讨论的半导体领域。

segments.en: And less than less money is going to the traditional real estate sector. As a result, you know, the FAI in real estate investments are actually going down very high double digit year and year in the latest figure.
segments.zh: 而流入传统房地产行业的资金越来越少。结果，房地产固定资产投资同比大幅下降，最新数据为两位数降幅。

segments.en: That is showing you that, you know, the economy is continuing to cut back on real estate investments, which is a good news, you know, basically the new money is going to, you know, more promising sector state is giving investors and the economy better return.
segments.zh: 这表明经济持续减少房地产投资，这是好消息，因为新增资金流向了更有前景的行业，为投资者和经济带来更好回报。

segments.en: And I think this trend would continue. So I think ever since early 2023, you know, we've seen, you know, the new monies on the PBOC balance sheet are going into high tech growth sector.
segments.zh: 我认为这一趋势将持续。自2023年初以来，央行资产负债表上的新增资金一直流向高科技成长行业。

segments.en: And also, if you look at the policy statement, you know, many of these new sectors are actually going to be the new growth engine for the Chinese economy.
segments.zh: 此外，从政策声明来看，这些新兴行业将成为中国经济的新增长引擎。
